name: 身体動作流暢性解析
algorithm: Body Movement Fluidity — ピクセルレベル空間分析
mechanism:
This method analyzes body movement naturalness for deepfake detection following Zheng et al. (2021):

1. **Pose推定**: Full-body or upper-body pose is estimated per frame using landmark detection (shoulders, elbows, wrists, head, torso). Joint angles and positions are tracked to build temporal motion trajectories for each body part.

2. **動きSmoothness分析**: Natural body movements follow minimum-jerk trajectories (Flash & Hogan, 1985) — meaning the third derivative of position (jerk) is minimized. The method computes jerk profiles for tracked joints. AI-generated body movements may violate this biological constraint, showing either excessive jerk (unnatural abruptness) or unnaturally perfect smoothness (lacking physiological tremor).

3. **JointCoordinationPatterns**: Natural movements exhibit coordinated joint motion governed by biomechanical coupling. The method analyzes inter-joint correlations — shoulder-elbow coordination during gestures, head-torso coupling during turns. Deepfakes may produce joints that move independently in physically impossible ways.

4. **時間的周波数分析**: Body motion signals are analyzed in frequency domain. Natural movements contain characteristic frequency components: voluntary motion (0-2 Hz), physiological tremor (~8-12 Hz), and postural sway (~0.5 Hz). Generated movements may lack these physiological frequency signatures or produce spectrally flat motion without natural frequency structure.

5. **Fluidityスコアリング**: Movement fluidity is quantified by combining jerk metrics, coordination scores, and spectral indicators. Low fluidity scores (jerky, uncoordinated, or spectrally abnormal motion) indicate AI generation. The method is particularly effective for full-body deepfakes where generation artifacts extend beyond the face region.
parameters:
分析タイプ: ピクセル
メディア: 動画
入力: Video frames extracted at key intervals
出力: 信頼度スコア (0-100)
Frame sampling: Adaptive (1-5 fps depending on method)
Temporal window: Sliding window across frame sequence
accuracy: 中〜高 — 70-88% 単独精度. Most effective when combined with other 動画 forensic methods. Performance depends on 動画 quality, resolution, and compression level.
source: Video forensics and deepfake detection research. Based on computer vision and temporal signal analysis methods.
useCase: Detection of deepfake and AI-generated 動画 through body movement fluidity analysis. This method examines temporal and spatial features that are difficult for AI systems to perfectly replicate, providing evidence for 動画 authenticity assessment.
strengths:
• Captures temporal artifacts that single-frame analysis misses
• Works with standard 動画 formats
• Effective against common deepfake techniques
• Can be combined with other 動画 forensic methods
• Based on established computer vision research
limitations:
• Performance affected by 動画 compression and resolution
• Some methods require sufficient frame count for temporal analysis
• Effectiveness varies with deepfake generation technique
• Best used as part of a comprehensive multi-method pipeline
• May produce false positives on heavily edited authentic 動画
